name: Sindile Road
description: After much controversy surrounding the construction of a road after the Kemet Invasion, the king finally ordered its creation. Connecting Yama, Mystical, and Tsvetan, the road was built with the aid of Earth Elementals, ensuring no tree will cover it. This road only skirts the periphery of Sindile and does not penetrate its depths. Some magical mosses and fungi provide some illumination by night, and earth elementals act as silent guides, helping travelers navigate the pathway. This road also magically erases any footprints, making it impossible to track. The Eternal Circle periodically makes some sabotages, creating dangers on the road or guiding people to strange places, even to the depths of the forest. They officially deny such actions, the more formidable the group crossing the road, the more probable they are to draw their attention. A few elven small villages can be found across the road, and even with restrictions, they can trade or offer guidance.
